'''Sundro Tam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> who lived during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge" /> Along with fellow Human [[Tarson Kestrel]], Tam was one of the leaders of a group of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] raiders who made a living by stealing contraband from [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and other outlaws. In about [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Tam and his men became stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]] after their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] broke down. He developed an addiction to the potent spice [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]], which he had acquired on the streets of Endregaad, and after spending several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] on the world, Tam's supplies of the drug were close to depletion. Tam learned that a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] carrying a cargo of the spice had crashed in Endregaad's [[Temple Valley]] and that the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika Anjiliac]] had camped out with some of his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] next to the crash-site, so Tam mustered a force of spice raiders and they set out to the crashed vessel on [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]], to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Mika and seize the spice.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> However, the attack failed and Tam was slain by [[Mander Zuma]], a [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] who had been sent to transport Mika off of Endregaad.<ref name="Scourge" />
